summary.text: The black sports car keeps its carbon-fibre identity as it rolls through a night tunnel, its surfaces shifting between porcelain-white highlights and deep shadow.

description.text: rolls from darkness into the mouth of a night tunnel. Its carbon-fibre body catches porcelain-white light in long, soft bands, while deep shadow keeps the cabin and wheels dark. The road surface glistens faintly, and the tunnel opening frames the car as it advances into the porcelain-shadow glow.
A low continuous tunnel ambience with soft rolling tire sound begins.
moves fully into the tunnel mouth as pale light slides across its body.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

glides deeper along the tunnel lane. Repeating shadow arches fold across its carbon-fibre body and the wet-looking road, making the porcelain-white highlights ripple and then recede. The dark cabin stays in contrast, and small reflections travel along the flanks as the car holds a steady line.
Soft rolling tire sound and faint air movement continue through the tunnel.
passes beneath another shadow arch, its body brightening and dimming in sequence.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

presses forward into a brighter wash of porcelain light at the tunnel's far end. Its carbon-fibre surfaces glow along the edges, while deep shadow holds the cabin and wheels. The pale light spreads over the road ahead, and the car's shape sharpens against the luminous haze before the frame closes.
The low tunnel ambience and soft tire sound continue as the car approaches the brighter exit.
reaches the bright wash, its edges rimmed with porcelain-white light.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
